description: This file defines the AllergyReaction class, which models allergy reactions within the OpenMRS medical records system. It includes fields for allergy, reaction concept, and non-coded reactions, along with standard getters, setters, and utility methods.

classes.name: AllergyReaction
classes.description: Represents an allergy reaction, linked to a specific allergy and possibly a coded or non-coded reaction description.

methods.name: getAllergyReactionId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the allergy reaction.

methods.name: setAllergyReactionId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the allergy reaction.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Implements the getId method from OpenmrsObject, returns the allergyReactionId.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the allergyReactionId, fulfilling OpenmrsObject's requirement.

methods.name: setAllergy
methods.description: Assigns an Allergy object to this reaction.

methods.name: getReaction
methods.description: Returns the Concept representing the reaction.

methods.name: setReaction
methods.description: Sets the Concept representing the allergy reaction.

methods.name: getReactionNonCoded
methods.description: Returns a non-coded description of the reaction.

methods.name: setReactionNonCoded
methods.description: Sets a non-coded description of the reaction.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the reaction, prioritizing non-coded description.

methods.name: hasSameValues
methods.description: Checks if this AllergyReaction has the same values as another, comparing IDs, reaction concepts, and non-coded descriptions.
